Estoril.name: Ian Cathro
Estoril.bio_ko: Ian Cathro is a Scottish football coach and former player who is the head coach of French Ligue 2 club Saint-Étienne.

Sporting CP.name: Rui Borges
Sporting CP.bio_ko: Rui Manuel Gomes Borges is a Portuguese professional football manager and former player who is the head coach of Primeira Liga club Sporting CP. He played as a winger for several clubs in Portugal, before starting a managerial career in 2017. In 2023 he broke into the Primeira Liga as head coach of Moreirense, and also coached Vitória de Guimarães before joining his current club, Sporting CP, in December 2024. He led Sporting CP to the 2024–25 Primeira Liga and Taça de Portugal titles.

Benfica.name: José Mourinho
Benfica.bio_ko: José Mário dos Santos Mourinho Félix is a Portuguese professional football manager and former player who is the head coach of La Liga club Real Madrid. Nicknamed "The Special One", he is one of the most decorated managers of all time. Mourinho has won league championships in four countries, is one of only seven managers to have won the European Cup with two clubs, and is the only manager to have won all three current UEFA club competitions. He was named Portuguese Coach of the Century by the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF) in 2015. Due to his tactical knowledge, charismatic and controversial personality, and a reputation for prioritising results over attractive football, he has drawn comparisons—from both admirers and critics—with Argentine manager Helenio Herrera.

Alverca.name: Custódio Castro
Alverca.bio_ko: 쿠스토디우 미겔 디아스 데 카스트루(포르투갈어: Custódio Miguel Dias de Castro, 1983년 5월 24일 ~)는 포르투갈의 전 축구 선수, 현 축구 감독이다. 선수 시절 포지션은 수비형 미드필더이다.

Estrela.name: Cristiano Bacci
Estrela.bio_ko: Cristiano Bacci is an Italian professional football manager and former player. He was most recently the manager of Primeira Liga club Tondela.
